svg.title: Automatic evaluation (AERI): three parts joined by versioned messages, one part with motion authority
svg.desc: A proposes events and judges goals and scenes, B grants resources and serves policy chunks, C alone may command motion and write the run journal. Messages from A or B carrying a robot or reset command are refused. Status: software with fake-I/O validation; hardware acceptance is pending.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Automatic evaluation: three parts, one authority

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The judge can say what happened; only one part can move the robot, and it writes the only journal.

svg.text: A robot or reset command key anywhere in a message from A or B (after Unicode normalisation) → E_CONTROL_FIELD.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A newer schema minor than the reader knows → refused (fail closed). An unknown field, a duplicate key, NaN → refused.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An unknown or unavailable verdict is never turned into success; an unknown physical command result is never re-sent.

svg.text: AERI is this pipeline's code name. The launch wizard and run window configure and show; they cannot give A or B motion authority.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: In the AERI subtask loop (earlier versions: external mode only on the robot) the vision model also plans subtasks; its “done” only moves the flow on.
